zh: 修复新窗口返回聊天时跳到旧窗口：每个窗口保留自己的聊天选择和未发送草稿，聊天与编辑器来回切换不丢失编辑状态。合并上游 v1.9.2，包括聊天标签恢复、模型目录及 OpenCode 兼容修复。保留任务栏新建窗口、全局翻译、快捷提问和专属签名更新通道；下载后仍由你确认重启安装。 优化长会话流式更新及鼠标监听线程，增加选区错位防护；Edge PDF 取词不一致问题仍未解决。
en: Fixes new windows returning to another window’s chat. Each window keeps its own selected conversation and unsent draft while retaining its editor state. Integrates upstream v1.9.2, including chat-tab restoration, model-catalog updates and OpenCode compatibility fixes. Retains taskbar New Window, global translation, Quick Ask and the custom signed update channel. Installation still requires confirming a restart. Optimizes long-chat streaming updates and isolates the Windows mouse hook from the UI thread. Adds selection geometry safeguards; incorrect text returned by Edge PDF remains unresolved.
